question: Which diseases are associated with the gene HGNC:3815?

WHERE seed.id IN ['HGNC:3815']
OPTIONAL MATCH (seed)-[r:`biolink:causes`|`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`|`biolink:contributes_to`|`biolink:genetically_associated_with`]->(obj:`biolink:Disease`)
RETURN

  seed.description AS subject_description,
  seed.category[0] AS subject_category,
  type(r) AS predicate_type,
  r.publications AS publications,
  r.primary_knowledge_source AS primary_knowledge_source,
  obj.id AS object_id,
  obj.name AS object_name,
  obj.description AS object_description,
  obj.category[0] AS object_category
